newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rubber stable in thin late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rubber stable in thin late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were stable in thin late trading on Friday, with few enquiries heard, dealers said.
Dealers said February/March SIR20 offer prices were at 55.25-55.75 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan, 55.00-55.25 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang as well as at 54.50-55.00 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
They said one Singapore firm was heard buying SIR20 at 55.00 fob Palembang in early trading, but added there were no fresh deals later in the day.
